name: ak:docs
overview: Analyze a codebase and create, refresh, summarize, or audit project documentation without imposing a fixed docs layout.
whenToUse: Invoke to create, refresh, summarize, or audit project documentation.

subcommands.name: init
subcommands.desc: Establish a minimal project-specific docs route

subcommands.name: update
subcommands.desc: Reconcile impacted docs with current evidence

subcommands.name: summarize
subcommands.desc: Summarize current evidence without forcing a new file
